newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Endesa Chile cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Endesa Chile cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Gilbert Casillas said he cut his rating on Empresa Nacional de Electricidad SA (Chile), or Endesa, to hold from buy.
-- He said he cut his 1996 earnings per share view to $1.16 from $1.22, his 1997 view to $0.72 from $1.21 and his 1998 forecast to $0.97 from $1.49.
-- He said the reason for the downgrade was twofold:

-- "The Chilean government recently announced a tariff decrease effective this month, which will significantly lower 1997 revenues, and the drought currently taking place in Chile will also have a negative impact by increasing the amount of thermoelectric generation the company must produce to fulfill its sales obligations," Casillas said.
-- Shares were down 1/2 at 17-1/8 on the NYSE.
